source.name: Silverstone Circuit
source.widthNote: Published circuit specification from MotoGP; modeled uniformly, not a longitudinal survey.
source.elevationNote: Flat placeholder: no longitudinal height survey is supplied. Zero is not a claim that the real circuit is flat.
source.runoffNote: Default gameplay runoff: 20 m of grass on each side, editable per zone. This deliberately differs from real-world safety areas, especially at street circuits.
source.layoutNote: Start/finish moved from the older pit straight in the dataset to the Hamilton Straight; exact timing-line placement is approximate.
